dataset: FlyEM MaleCNS v1.0, min confidence 0.5, traced-only segment pairs (derived)

roster.note: P0.1 名册：graph600 = v1 全部 80 细胞 (body-ID 80/80 在内) + 520 新细胞。新细胞按 role 分层供选择性消融使用；主消融口径只静音 496 中间神经元，保留 24 个新感觉输入细胞 (否则将移除 56 输入中的 24 个 = 43% 感觉门)。

selection: Weighted pathway closure grown deterministically from the 80 cells of graph.json v1: three rounds taking the top (120, 120, 240) candidates by total synaptic contacts (>=3 per edge, either direction) to the current set, ties by lower body ID; candidates restricted to status=Traced, annotated type, soma location present; filled to exactly 600. Readout cells unchanged (the original 16 DNs). Input cells: every set member whose annotated type is one of the 8 channel types. All induced directed edges >=3 contacts retained. No game outcomes used. Derived node metadata reproduced the shipped 80-cell v1 graph byte-for-byte from the same sources before growing.
assumptions: Engineered 8-channel input injection; simplified signed, normalized, leaky tanh rate units. Acetylcholine +1, GABA/glutamate -1; unknown and modulatory transmitters 0. Neurotransmitter call = consensus_nt when predicted_nt_confidence >= 0.5 else unclear. Not a physiological or whole-brain model.

derived.derivation: remove all new->DN edges (833), restore all pruned v1 edges (450, incl 114 into DN); DN edge set + per-post totals bit-identical to v1
